field.filter: SELECT AHWSProductVersion AS V WHERE V.product_id = :this->product_id AND V.status = 'active'
SELECT Person AS p JOIN lnkPersonToTeam AS l ON l.person_id=p.id JOIN Team AS t ON l.team_id=t.id WHERE t.id = :this->team_id

dashlet.title: AHWSIssue:Overview:MyActiveIssues
dashlet.query: SELECT AHWSIssue WHERE assignee_id = :current_contact_id AND status IN ("unconfirmed", "confirmed", "inprogress")

dashlet.title: AHWSIssue:Overview:OpenedIssuesForActiveMilestone
dashlet.query: SELECT AHWSIssue JOIN AHWSMilestone ON AHWSIssue.milestone_id = AHWSMilestone.id WHERE AHWSIssue.status IN ("unconfirmed", "confirmed", "inprogress") AND AHWSMilestone.start_date <= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y-%m-%d') AND AHWSMilestone.due_date >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y-%m-%d')

dashlet.title: AHWSIssue:Overview:OpenedIssuesByProduct
dashlet.query: SELECT AHWSIssue JOIN AHWSProduct ON AHWSIssue.product_id = AHWSProduct.id WHERE AHWSIssue.status IN ("unconfirmed", "confirmed", "inprogress") AND AHWSProduct.status = "active"

dashlet.title: AHWSIssue:Overview:IssuesRecentlyUpdated
dashlet.query: SELECT AHWSIssue WHERE update_date >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 15 DAY),'%Y-%m-%d 00:00:00')

dashlet.title: AHWSProduct:Overview:AllProductInActiveMilestone
dashlet.query: SELECT AHWSProduct JOIN AHWSIssue ON AHWSIssue.product_id = AHWSProduct.id JOIN AHWSMilestone ON AHWSIssue.milestone_id = AHWSMilestone.id WHERE AHWSProduct.status = "active" AND AHWSIssue.status IN ("unconfirmed", "confirmed", "inprogress") AND AHWSMilestone.start_date <= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y-%m-%d') AND AHWSMilestone.due_date >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y-%m-%d')

dashlet.title: AHWSProduct:Overview:InactiveProductWithOpenedIssue
dashlet.query: SELECT AHWSProduct JOIN AHWSIssue ON AHWSIssue.product_id = AHWSProduct.id WHERE AHWSProduct.status = "inactive" AND AHWSIssue.status IN ("unconfirmed", "confirmed", "inprogress")

dashlet.title: AHWSMilestone:Overview:ActiveMilestone
dashlet.query: SELECT AHWSMilestone WHERE start_date <= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y-%m-%d') AND due_date >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y-%m-%d')

dashlet.title: AHWSMilestone:Overview:InactiveMilestoneWithOpenedIssues
dashlet.query: SELECT AHWSMilestone JOIN AHWSIssue ON AHWSIssue.milestone_id = AHWSMilestone.id WHERE AHWSMilestone.start_date > DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y-%m-%d') AND AHWSMilestone.due_date < DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y-%m-%d') AND AHWSIssue.status IN ("unconfirmed", "confirmed", "inprogress")
